newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -3 Jan 19 week.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -3 Jan 19 week.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News index of consumer comfort held steady at -3.0 in the week ended January 26.

The survey, this time with 1,038 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
Respondents' confidence in the economy rose to -2.0 from -4.0 the previous week.
Confidence in personal finances dipped to 18 from 20, while Americans' rating of buying climate rose two points to -24.

Confidence rose in all major regions of the nation except the West, where it dropped to -4.0 from -1.0, the report said. The Northeast advanced to -1.0 from -3.0, the Midwest rose -2.0 from -3.0 and the South rose to -3.0 from -5.0.
